title: Pan2023: Cross-session motor imagery dataset from Pan et al. 2023
description: A cross-session motor imagery EEG dataset from 14 healthy participants who performed cued left- versus right-hand motor imagery on two separate days. EEG was recorded from 28 channels at 250 Hz with a Neuroscan SynAmps2 amplifier, with 120 trials per session. The dataset supports research on brain-computer interfaces and on decoding methods that must cope with variability across sessions.
methods_description: Each session consisted of four blocks of 30 trials (15 left, 15 right, in random order) separated by 5 min breaks. Each 7 s trial had a 1 s 'Ready' preparation with a beep, a 4 s task period showing a left- or right-handed rowing game animation with sound, and a 2 s rest. EEG was recorded from 28 channels in a 10-10 montage, referenced to the nose, with a forehead ground, at 250 Hz and a 0.01-200 Hz online bandpass plus a 50 Hz notch.
